hook: Your country put 104 satellites up with one rocket.
title: Your Country Launched 104 Satellites at Once
description:
In February 2017, ISRO's PSLV-C37 carried 104 satellites into orbit on a single launch from Sriharikota. It was a world record at the time. Part of the series: India In Space.

#Shorts #ISRO #Space
comment_prompt: Proud of ISRO? Yes or no
